Espresso basics

This page covers espresso: fresh beans, a steady grind and clean water matter most.

Weigh the coffee and the water so every brew can be repeated.

Taste, change one variable, and taste again before changing anything else.

Dose eighteen grams, yield thirty-six grams, and stop the shot around twenty-eight seconds.

Purge the group head, dry the basket and distribute the grounds evenly before tamping.

Clean the portafilter between shots so old oils do not turn the next shot bitter.

Example Coffee Lab, brewing notes since 2019.
